pr_title: Refactor osu!taiko playfield and add background skinning support
pr_body:
This PR contains a few changes that are too intertwined to easily split up (sorry).

- Refactors `TaikoPlayfield` to be easier to understand.
- Adds custom scale adjust logic to legacy skinnables which need to be rendered at specific sizes (bypassing the otherwise relative context). A bit ugly that we need this in update methods, but local to legacy components and commented as such.
- Removes a weird size update line in `DrawableHit`. This can be split out into another PR if desired. I've tested and this was never actually making a valid change (value is constant).
- Adds `PlayfieldBackgroundRight` and `PlayfieldBackgroundLeft` for skinning

Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/8844.
